"POWELL RIVER LOGGING AND PULP MILL OPERATIONS. Tough, snubbly little tugs bring the huge, quarter-mile-long booms up the coast from Stillwater to the log pond below the Powell River Company's mighty mill. Boom man here pole them to the jack ladder which carries them into the sawmill." (Inscription)

images.caption: The Powell River Paper Mill first incorporated in 1909 is still a leading producer of high-quality uncoated mechanical specialty papers. With three paper machines producing diverse grades, it employs some 410 people. The mill currently owned by Catalyst Paper is still in operation as September 26, 2013. The date this photo was taken. Photo by Robert Dall
